history.summary: A freehold 2008 3BR at Tessa Lodge (D15) for $2.78M, but the 1,851 sqft floor area makes the headline $1,502 psf misleading — this is a very large unit at a high absolute quantum. Thin URA data (2 txns) and a >$2.7M ticket in a boutique make the investment case soft despite freehold and TEL access.
history.rating_rationale: The low-looking $1,502 psf is a size artefact — an oversized 1,851 sqft 3BR — so it's not actually cheap; the absolute $2.78M sits above the deepest buyer band. URA data is unusable (only 2 txns), and PSF is ~8% below the $1,630 median, plausibly because large old units trade down on PSF. Positives: freehold, 520m to TE25 Tanjong Katong (Thomson-East Coast Line) in desirable D15. For investment, the heavy quantum, thin liquidity for an outsized layout, and weak data hold it at Neutral.
red_flags: Oversized 1,851 sqft inflates value perception — $1,502 psf is not genuinely cheap
$2.78M quantum above the deepest buyer pool; outsized layout narrows demand
Only 2 URA transactions — appreciation rate unreliable
catalysts: Freehold in prime D15, 520m to TE25 Tanjong Katong (TEL)
Large livable layout appeals to own-stay families if priced right
